title: Open my project from its bridge URL
as: client engineer, first day with DataPass
goal: Open the Codex Wind Lab project from the bridge repository's URL and see the three code repositories in one architecture.
hints: Use "DataPass: Open a Client Project…" with the bridge URL
expected: The workspace opens with the bridge first, then wind-study-2d, wind-blade-3d and wind-platform
The Architecture panel shows the components of all three repositories
Each component names its repository and folder
No sign-in and no cloud call is asked for
